dataset_or_product: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance (B04, B08, B11, B12) and scene classification (SCL)
provider: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (openEO), European Union / ESA
geography: Sangrur (pre-2021 boundary), Punjab
resolution: 20 m (nearest neighbour from 10 m and 20 m bands); 5-day median composites
licence_or_terms: Free and open Copernicus data licence; credit "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025"
preprocessing: Scene classes kept: 2, 4, 5, 6, 7; scenes over 80% cloud skipped; median per window; clipped to the district polygon; reflectance offset checked on the pilot box
known_limitations: Cloud and smoke can hide burns; scars can be ploughed under within days; the scene classification can mislabel burnt fields; damp soil under a young crop can pass the burn tests, so burns first seen late in the season are reported as unconfirmed

known_limitations: 30 m pixels blur small fields and edges; Fmask may not flag smoke haze as cloud (high aerosol is flagged separately); used only to interpret labels by eye
